typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		Requestor as string,
		Incident as decimal(18,0),
		Summary as string,
		Location as string,
		{Submit Date} as timestamp,
		{Close Date} as string,
		Department as string,
		Service as string,
		Category as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		CloseDate2 = iif(isNull({Close Date}) || length(trim(toString({Close Date}))) == 0, toTimestamp(null()), toTimestamp(toString({Close Date}, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		Category as string,
		SubmitDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Service as string,
		FName as string,
		CloseDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EtlUser as string,
		Department as string,
		Summary as string,
		Incident as integer,
		Requestor as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		UploadDate,
		Category,
		SubmitDate = {Submit Date},
		Service,
		FName,
		CloseDate = CloseDate2,
		EtlUser,
		Department,
		Summary,
		Incident,
		Requestor,
		Location),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
